subject: RE: Change Mtg Date???
body_plain:
Vince:  We will see you and Stinson at 7am at the Hyatt on Thursday.  Al

----- Original Message -----
From: <Vince.J.Kaminski@enron.com>
To: <arfsten@bflassociates.com>
Sent: Monday, November 26, 2001 8:29 AM
Subject: RE: Change Mtg Date???


> Al,
>
> Thursday would work for me.
>
> Vince
>
>     -----Original Message-----
>    From:   "Al Arfsten" <arfsten@bflassociates.com>@ENRON
>    Sent:   Monday, November 26, 2001 8:31 AM
>    To:     VKaminski@aol.com
>    Cc:     vkamins@enron.com
>    Subject:  Fw: Change Mtg Date???
>
>
>    Vince:  Bjorn must be in Chicago Wednesday so  we must move the meeting
>    to Tuesday or Thursday, if that is possible.   Otherwise, give me other
>    possibilities.  Thanks, Al
>    ----- Original Message -----
>    From: Al  Arfsten << File: mailto:arfsten@bflassociates.com >>
>    To: VKaminski@aol.com << File: mailto:VKaminski@aol.com >>
>    Cc: bjorn@bflassociates.com << File: mailto:bjorn@bflassociates.com >>
>    Sent: Tuesday, November 20, 2001 11:45 AM
>    Subject: Re: Meeting next week
>    Vince:  That works for us at the Hyatt Regency  at 7am.  The earlier
the
>    better on the Plan.  See you soon.   Al
>    ----- Original Message -----
>    From:  VKaminski@aol.com << File: mailto:VKaminski@aol.com >>
>    To: arfsten@bflassociates.com << File: mailto:arfsten@bflassociates.com
>    >>
>    Sent: Tuesday, November 20, 2001 11:23  AM
>    Subject: Meeting next week
>    Al,
>    What about  meeting Stinson on Wednesday next week (after Thanksgiving)
>    at 7:00 a.m.,  Hyatt Regency? We should be able to E-mail you the
>    business plan outline the  day before.
>    Have a Happy Thanksgiving.
>    Vince
>
>
